mapper.select: SELECT person_id,full_name,phone FROM person WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND (full_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY full_name,person_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT pu.property_unit_id,b.community_id,c.community_name,CONCAT(b.building_no,'号楼') building_name,COALESCE(bu.unit_name,CONCAT(bu.unit_no,'单元')) unit_name,pu.property_no,pu.occupancy_status,pu.version FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id WHERE pu.status='ACTIVE' AND pu.occupancy_status IN ('VACANT','AVAILABLE_FOR_RENT') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM residence r WHERE r.property_unit_id=pu.property_unit_id AND r.end_date IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ownership o WHERE o.person_id=#{personId} AND o.property_unit_id=pu.property_unit_id AND o.end_date IS NULL) AND b.community_id IN #{id} AND 1=0 ORDER BY c.community_name,b.building_no,bu.unit_no,pu.property_no

SELECT pu.property_unit_id,b.community_id,pu.status,pu.occupancy_status,pu.version FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id WHERE pu.property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM person WHERE person_id=#{personId} AND status='ACTIVE')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ownership WHERE person_id=#{personId} AND property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND end_date IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE property_unit SET occupancy_status=#{occupancyStatus},version=version+1 WHERE property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE' AND occupancy_status IN ('VACANT','AVAILABLE_FOR_RENT')
mapper.select: SELECT r.residence_id,r.property_unit_id,b.community_id,r.residence_role,r.start_date,pu.version property_version,pu.occupancy_status FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id=r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id WHERE r.residence_id=#{residenceId} AND r.end_date IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE residence SET end_date=#{endDate} WHERE residence_id=#{residenceId} AND end_date IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM residence WHERE property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND end_date IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental_listing WHERE property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','PUBLISHED'))
mapper.update: UPDATE property_unit SET occupancy_status=#{occupancyStatus},version=version+1 WHERE property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND version=#{version} AND occupancy_status='TENANT_OCCUPIED'
